description: This Java class 'SchemaOnlyTuner' modifies Liquibase schema snapshots by transforming specific data types and removing certain change sets related to Liquibase metadata tables. It operates by parsing and manipulating XML documents representing database schema snapshots.

classes.name: SchemaOnlyTuner
classes.description: A class for adjusting Liquibase schema-only snapshots by replacing data types and removing Liquibase-specific tables.

methods.name: updateChangeLog
methods.description: Overrides a method to perform multiple transformations on the provided XML document, replacing data types and detaching specific tables.

methods.name: detachLiquibaseTables
methods.description: Removes Liquibase metadata tables 'liquibasechangelog' and 'liquibasechangeloglock' from the XML document.

methods.name: detachChangeSet
methods.description: Removes a specific change set from the XML document based on the table name.

methods.name: replaceBitWithBoolean
methods.description: Finds columns of type BIT and replaces them with BOOLEAN, also adjusting default values accordingly.

methods.name: replaceLongtextWithClob
methods.description: Replaces columns of type LONGTEXT with CLOB in the snapshot.

methods.name: assertLongtextNodes
methods.description: Verifies that exactly one LONGTEXT column exists in a specific table, used as an assertion during transformation.
